name: Vercel
description: The Vercel team (scope) the CLI works in. Switched machine-wide with `vercel teams switch`; the Vercel CLI reads no environment variable for the team on its own, so profiles can't pick it per server.

fields.label: Team
fields.list: vercel teams ls --json --limit 100 --non-interactive 2>/dev/null | node -e 'const r = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")); for (const t of r.teams) console.log(t.slug + "\t" + t.name + "\t" + (t.plan || ""))'
fields.current: vercel teams ls --json --limit 100 --non-interactive 2>/dev/null | node -e 'const r = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")); for (const t of r.teams) if (t.current) console.log(t.slug)'
